nodes.label: Drag and Drop Deployment
nodes.rationale: Presented as the easiest method: run npm run build:netlify and drag the build folder onto Netlify so the app is live immediately.

nodes.label: Git Integration Deployment
nodes.rationale: Recommended because connecting the GitHub repository lets Netlify detect build settings automatically from netlify.toml.

nodes.label: Caching Headers
nodes.rationale: Caching headers are configured in netlify.toml so optimized static assets load quickly.

nodes.label: qrcode.js Engine
nodes.rationale: react-qr-code was replaced with the qrcode library so dots, rounded corners, gradients, and drop shadows can be drawn with custom SVG.

nodes.label: SVG Rendering
nodes.rationale: SVG is used for vector quality; canvas is the fallback when simple styles need better performance.

nodes.label: Canvas Fallback
nodes.rationale: Canvas is the performance path for simple QR styles, while SVG remains the quality path for styled codes.

nodes.label: SPA Redirects
nodes.rationale: A _redirects file was added so Netlify serves the single-page app on client-side routes.

nodes.label: High Error Correction
nodes.rationale: High error correction is used so a QR code stays scannable after a center logo is embedded.

nodes.label: Progressive Enhancement
nodes.rationale: Progressive enhancement is used so the app degrades gracefully when advanced styling is unavailable.

nodes.label: Text Limits
nodes.rationale: Input is auto-truncated so oversized payloads do not crash QR generation.

nodes.label: Developer Footer
nodes.rationale: The footer shows developer identity and stays readable on small screens by adapting to the dark-mode theme.

nodes.label: Visual Styles
nodes.rationale: Rounded style uses soft corners for a friendlier look than classic squares or circular dots.

nodes.label: Center Logo
nodes.rationale: A white background and shadow keep the center logo visible, and high error correction keeps the code scannable.

nodes.label: qrService
nodes.rationale: QR payload generation and validation sit in a services module so UI components do not own that business logic.

nodes.label: In-Browser Generation
nodes.rationale: QR codes are generated entirely in the browser with no sign-up, so payload data is not sent to a server.

nodes.label: No-JavaScript Fallback
nodes.rationale: A static noscript block describes the generator for crawlers and tells visitors to enable JavaScript.
